==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Rank #1 in Korean solo queue at the end of Season 6 and 9.
* Known for his exceptional {{ci|Gragas}}, {{ci|Reksai}}, and {{ci|Nidalee}} plays and mechanics.<ref>[https://t1.gg/teams/league-of-legends League of Legends] ''t1.gg''</ref>
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Reksai}}, and {{ci|Nidalee}}.<ref>[https://t1.gg/teams/league-of-legends League of Legends] ''t1.gg''</ref>
* Went to the same middle school as [[Roach]].<ref>[https://youtu.be/cTaxZmJEXYg?t=343 Wolf: Effort, I love you! | T1 WIN CAM Moments EP.1 <nowiki>[</nowiki>Translated<nowiki>]</nowiki>] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Has flash on F.
* Plays League of Legends windowed.
* Is part of a small echelon of Korean players who are 'royal roaders': players who win the very first split they competed in. He did so by winning the [[LCK/2017_Season/Summer_Playoffs|LCK 2017 Summer]] with [[Longzhu Gaming]].
* His {{ci|Dr Mundo}} pick during [[Worlds 2025]] took inspiration from [[SkewMond]].<ref>[https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1987198660220748283 Sheep Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on June 30, 2023.
** Was the 23rd player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK, after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]], [[Rascal]], [[deokdam]] and [[Canyon]]
** The fifth jungler to reach 1000 kills after [[Score]], [[Ambition]], [[Peanut]] and [[Canyon]].
* Reached 1500 LCK kills on September 13, 2025
** Was the 19th player and 4th jungler to reach 1500 kills in the LCK.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on August 10, 2023.
** Was the 14th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], [[Bdd]], [[Keria]], [[Life]], [[BeryL]], and [[Canyon]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LCK on May 29, 2025.
** Was the 10th player to reach 4000 assists in the LCK after GorillA, Faker, Lehends, Peanut, Keria, Deft, Bdd, BeryL, and Canyon.
* Reached 300 wins in [[LCK]] on August 19, 2023, becoming the 13th player to do so after [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[GorillA]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Peanut]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[ShowMaker]], and [[Lehends]]/[[Kiin]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on February 16, 2024, becoming the 12th player to do so.
* Reached 600 games in the LCK on May 09, 2025, becoming the 11th player to do so.

=== Awards ===
* LCK Final MVP x1 (Spring 2020)
* LCK 1st All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2023)
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2020)
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2020)
